title: Nuclear resonant scattering of Synchrotron radiation from nuclei in the Browninan motion
abstract: The time evolution of the coherent forward scattering of Synchrotron radiation for resonant nuclei in Brownian motion is studied . Apart from target thickness, the appearance of dynamical beats also depends on $α$ which is the ratio of harmonic force constant to the damping force constant of a harmonic oscillator undergoing Brownian motion.
